citations.quote: At maximum courage, Kled remounts with a portion of Skaarl's health.

core_mechanics.summary: Fighting can restore Courage and allow a remount.

purpose: Recognize Kled's fighting pattern, damage focus and remount threat.
title: Kled

citations.quote: Outside of the fountain, Kled cannot gain Courage for 30 seconds after re-mounting.
Frayed Nerves duration changed to 12 seconds.

advanced_exceptions.summary: A post-remount Courage lockout is documented, but its duration is inconsistent.

citations.quote: When Skaarl's health depletes, Kled dismounts, cleansing from all crowd control.
becoming unable to act, untargetable, and immune to crowd control for 0.5 seconds

core_mechanics.summary: Losing Skaarl triggers a crowd-control cleanse and brief untargetability.

citations.quote: Kled gains a large amount of bonus movement speed when facing visible enemy champions, bonus armor and bonus magic resistance
He can also restore Courage from hitting enemies with Pocket Pistol.

core_mechanics.summary: Dismounted Kled has defensive bonuses and can rebuild Courage through combat.

citations.quote: Bear Trap on a Rope is replaced with Pocket Pistol, while Jousting and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! become unusable.
Mounting up resets the cooldowns of Bear Trap on a Rope and Jousting.

core_mechanics.summary: Dismount changes available abilities; remount refreshes mounted Q and E.

purpose: Recognize dismount protection and the combat-driven remount threat.
title: Skaarl, the Cowardly Lizard

citations.quote: forms a tether against the first champion or large monster hit, revealing them
if it is not broken before then, Kled pulls the target 150 units toward him, deals physical damage and slows them for 2.5 seconds.

core_mechanics.summary: A revealing tether leads to a damaging pull and slow if maintained.

purpose: Recognize the tether and respond before its delayed pull.
title: Bear Trap on a Rope

citations.quote: Kled periodically gains Violent Tendencies, which starts expiring upon his next basic attack.
The final attack deals additional physical damage based on the target's maximum health.

core_mechanics.summary: A passive attack-speed burst ends with an empowered maximum-health-based hit.

citations.quote: While on-cooldown, Violent Tendencies' current cooldown is reduced on-hit, greatly increased when hitting champions.

core_mechanics.summary: Hits accelerate its recharge, especially against champions.

purpose: Recognize the passive burst and its changing recharge window.
title: Violent Tendencies

citations.quote: The mark reveals the target for a short time, during which Jousting can be recast. Recast: Skaarl consumes the mark to dash through the marked target.

core_mechanics.summary: A marked, revealed target enables a follow-up dash.

citations.quote: Skaarl dashes in the target direction, though not through terrain
applying the same effects as the first cast though being able to dash through terrain

core_mechanics.summary: Terrain crossing is available on the recast.

purpose: Recognize the marked follow-up dash and its terrain access.
title: Jousting

citations.quote: building up bonus movement speed and shield and leaving a draft in their wake that grants Mr. Kled's Wild Ride to allies that follow the draft
immune to crowd control

core_mechanics.summary: The charge grants speed, shielding and crowd-control immunity while accelerating following allies.

citations.quote: colliding with the first visible enemy champion in their path to deal magic damage
knock them back 150 units
The damage dealt is based on time spent traveling before the beginning of the dash.

core_mechanics.summary: The ram deals magic damage and knockback, with damage increasing through prior travel.

purpose: Recognize the team engage and its protected approach.
title: Chaaaaaaaarge!!!

citations.quote: Pocket Pistol can be cast while grounded or rooted but Kled will not dash backwards.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Grounding or rooting prevents recoil but does not prevent the shot.

citations.quote: Kled sprays a cone of pellets in the target direction that deal physical damage to enemies hit, during which he also recoils backward.
Each pellet that hits an enemy champion or epic monster restores Courage.

core_mechanics.summary: A pellet cone combines backward recoil with Courage generation.

citations.quote: The backwards dash from Pocket Pistol can pass through terrain.
He will restore both charges after dismounting.

core_mechanics.summary: The recoil crosses terrain, and dismounting replenishes charges.

purpose: Distinguish the dismounted shot, recoil and remount contribution from mounted Q.
title: Pocket Pistol
